credits.title: Credits
credits.intro: Agora uses freely licensed assets. Thanks to their authors.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Agora is hosted on local infrastructure. No data is sent to third parties.

collected.p: Your display name, avatar choices, status, “Everyone” messages, and join and leave times.

notStored.p: Nearby chat, your movement history, audio and video.

floor.p: Anyone near you on the open floor can hear you. For a confidential conversation, go into a meeting room.

rooms.p: The server only links audio, video and chat between people inside the same room.

media.p: Camera and mic are off by default. Audio, video and shared screens only reach the people the server connects you with, through Agora's media server (or directly between browsers). They are never recorded.

retention.p: “Everyone” messages: 365 days by default. Presence times: 90 days.

contact.p: To access or delete your information, contact the person in charge of the protection of personal information.

privacy.introCloud: Agora is hosted on local infrastructure. No data is sent to third parties unless you agree to talk to the AI characters (see “Talking to characters”).

npcs.p: Characters are programs run by the server, not people. They only see people on the open floor (never in a private room, desk pod or quiet zone), and only your first name, status and position. Their decisions are made on the host’s own machine.

npcTalk.p: Only what you write in the “Talk to…” box reaches a character, never chat. The message is sorted on the host’s own machine. Most replies are prepared and never leave the server.
npcTalk.pCloud: Only what you write in the “Talk to…” box reaches a character, never chat. When no prepared line fits, your message and first name are sent to a cloud AI model ({{provider}}, {{country}}), after you agree. Emails, numbers, postal codes and links are removed first, and a message containing any is never sent. The text is not kept in logs. You can withdraw your agreement at any time.

npcMemory.p: After a useful conversation a character may keep short notes (600 characters) about what you said about your work or preferences, never personal identifiers. Only you can see them, they expire after a period without a visit (90 days by default), and you can delete them any time with “Forget everything” in the “Talk to…” box, by withdrawing your agreement, or with your account.

npcWeb.p: When the host has turned searches on, a question about the news or the outside world may be searched on the web through the host’s own search engine (SearXNG), which passes it on to the engines it uses. Only the words of the question leave, without first names or character names, and never a message that contains personal information. The quoted excerpts come from public sites, are treated as untrusted text, and their sites are shown under the reply. Turning this on asks everyone for their agreement again.

notice.title: Notice: AI-powered characters

notice.rules: Only the text written in this box is sent, with your first name. Emails, numbers, postal codes and links are removed first, and a message containing any stays on this server. The text is not kept in logs. You can withdraw your consent at any time with the “Withdraw my AI consent” button at the bottom of this box.

The sites quoted are shown under the reply.
